```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
# Also saved as .R file to call it later.
build_season_dataset <- function(current_data,
                                 previous_data,
                                 season_label,
                                 alpha = 0.1) {

  matches <- current_data %>%
    mutate(
      Date = dmy(as.character(Date)),
      Year = season_label,
      match_id = paste0(
        gsub("/", "", season_label),
        "_",
        row_number()
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id) # This is just preparing the dataset, creating a match id for individual matches

  previous_season_matches <- bind_rows(
    previous_data %>%
      transmute(
        Team = HomeTeam,
        goals_for = FTHG,
        goals_against = FTAG,
        result = case_when(
          FTR == "H" ~ "W",
          FTR == "A" ~ "L",
          FTR == "D" ~ "D"
        )
      ), # here, we collect the results for the previous season's matches for the home team

    previous_data %>%
      transmute(
        Team = AwayTeam,
        goals_for = FTAG,
        goals_against = FTHG,
        result = case_when(
          FTR == "A" ~ "W",
          FTR == "H" ~ "L",
          FTR == "D" ~ "D"
        )
      ) # here, we collect the results for the previous season's matches for the away team
  )

  previous_season_stats <- previous_season_matches %>%
    group_by(Team) %>% # all the calculations are performed for individual teams
    summarise(
      previous_season_goals_scored_per_match =
        mean(goals_for), # get an everage of goals scored

      previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match =
        mean(goals_against), # average of goals against

      previous_season_wins = sum(result == "W"),
      previous_season_draws = sum(result == "D"),
      previous_season_losses = sum(result == "L"),
          # sum up the amount of wins, draws and losses
      
      previous_season_points =
        sum(if_else(
          result == "W", 3,
          if_else(result == "D", 1, 0)
        )),  # total amount of points each team got in the previous season

      previous_season_goal_difference =
        sum(goals_for - goals_against), # Makes sure that every team has a unique rank if teams have the same amount of points

      previous_season_goals_scored = sum(goals_for), # Makes sure that every team has a unique rank if teams have the same amount of points

      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(previous_season_points),
      desc(previous_season_goal_difference),
      desc(previous_season_goals_scored) # team ranking during the previous season
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      previous_season_ranking = row_number(),
      RankCategory = case_when(
        previous_season_ranking <= 3  ~ "Top3",
        previous_season_ranking <= 7  ~ "4to7",
        previous_season_ranking <= 12 ~ "8to12",
        previous_season_ranking <= 17 ~ "13to17",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ) # we don't care about the last three because they do not participate in the following season
    )

  # Promoted teams: mean of the previous season's bottom three statistics 
  bottom3 <- previous_season_stats %>%
    slice_max(previous_season_ranking, n = 3)

  promoted_scored   <- mean(bottom3$previous_season_goals_scored_per_match)
  promoted_conceded <- mean(bottom3$previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match)


  home_data <- matches %>% # retrieves data for the home team of any match
    transmute(
      match_id, Date, Year,
      Team = HomeTeam,
      Opponent = AwayTeam,
      HomeAway = "Home",
      goals_for = FTHG,
      goals_against = FTAG,

      result = case_when(
        FTR == "H" ~ "W",
        FTR == "D" ~ "D",
        FTR == "A" ~ "L"
      ), 

      red_cards = HR,
      yellow_cards = HY,
      fouls = HF,
      corners = HC,
      shots = HS,
      shots_on_target = HST
    )

  away_data <- matches %>% # retrieves data for the away team of any match
    transmute(
      match_id, Date, Year,
      Team = AwayTeam,
      Opponent = HomeTeam,
      HomeAway = "Away",
      goals_for = FTAG,
      goals_against = FTHG,

      result = case_when(
        FTR == "A" ~ "W",
        FTR == "D" ~ "D",
        FTR == "H" ~ "L"
      ),

      red_cards = AR,
      yellow_cards = AY,
      fouls = AF,
      corners = AC,
      shots = AS,
      shots_on_target = AST
    )

  team_matches <- bind_rows(home_data, away_data) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id, HomeAway) 
  # this just lists fixtures with their respective match id

  team_features <- team_matches %>% # adds data to the fixtures 
    group_by(Team) %>% # information is sorted out by team names
    arrange(Date, match_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      matches_played = row_number() - 1L, 
    # this ensures that there is no info on the current match in the match's row

      previous_match_date = lag(Date),

      days_since_last_match = as.numeric(
        Date - previous_match_date
      ), # pretty self explanatory 

      wins = lag(cumsum(result == "W"), default = 0L), 
      draws = lag(cumsum(result == "D"), default = 0L),
      losses = lag(cumsum(result == "L"), default = 0L),
  # proportion of wins, draws and losses in games the team has played so far
  
      goals_scored_total =
        lag(cumsum(goals_for), default = 0), 
  # proportion of goals scored in games the team has played so far

      goals_conceded_total =
        lag(cumsum(goals_against), default = 0),
  # proportion of goals conceded in games the team has played so far

      red_cards_total =
        lag(cumsum(red_cards), default = 0),
  # proportion of red cards in games the team has played so far

      yellow_cards_total =
        lag(cumsum(yellow_cards), default = 0),

      fouls_total =
        lag(cumsum(fouls), default = 0),

      corners_total =
        lag(cumsum(corners), default = 0),

      shots_total =
        lag(cumsum(shots), default = 0),

      shots_on_target_total =
        lag(cumsum(shots_on_target), default = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      win_frequency = wins / pmax(matches_played, 1),
      loss_frequency = losses / pmax(matches_played, 1),
      draw_frequency = draws / pmax(matches_played, 1),

      goals_scored_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        goals_scored_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      goals_conceded_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        goals_conceded_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      red_cards_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        red_cards_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      yellow_cards_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        yellow_cards_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      fouls_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        fouls_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      corners_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        corners_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      shots_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        shots_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      ),

      shots_on_target_per_match = if_else(
        matches_played > 0,
        shots_on_target_total / matches_played,
        NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    left_join(
      previous_season_stats %>%
        select(
          Team,
          previous_season_goals_scored_per_match,
          previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match,
          previous_season_wins,
          previous_season_draws,
          previous_season_losses,
          previous_season_ranking,
          RankCategory
        ),
      by = "Team"
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      previous_season_goals_scored_per_match =
        coalesce(previous_season_goals_scored_per_match, promoted_scored),
      previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match =
        coalesce(previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match, promoted_conceded),
      RankCategory = coalesce(RankCategory, "Promoted")
    )

  # Calculate exponentially weighted attack and defence scores
  team_features <- team_features %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    arrange(Date, match_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      d <- .x
      n <- nrow(d)

      # Initialise scores using previous-season averages
      attack <- d$previous_season_goals_scored_per_match[1]
      defence <- d$previous_season_goals_conceded_per_match[1]

      d$attack_score <- numeric(n)
      d$defence_score <- numeric(n)

      for (i in seq_len(n)) {

        # Store scores before this match takes place
        d$attack_score[i] <- attack
        d$defence_score[i] <- defence

        # Update scores using this match for the next match
        attack <- alpha * d$goals_for[i] +
          (1 - alpha) * attack

        defence <- alpha * d$goals_against[i] +
          (1 - alpha) * defence
      }

      d
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  opponent_features <- team_features %>%
    select(
      match_id, Team,
      matches_played,
      days_since_last_match,
      RankCategory,
  
      win_frequency,
      loss_frequency,
      draw_frequency,
      attack_score,
      defence_score,

      red_cards_per_match,
      yellow_cards_per_match,
      fouls_per_match,
      corners_per_match,
      shots_on_target_per_match,
      shots_per_match
    ) %>%
    rename_with(
      ~ paste0("opp_", .x),
      -c(match_id, Team)
    ) %>%
    rename(Opponent = Team)
  # This take team features and mirrors the structure to reflect opponent features within a given match

  team_features %>%
    left_join(
      opponent_features,
      by = c("match_id", "Opponent") # For the appropriate match, add the opponent features
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TeamRankCategory = RankCategory,
      OpponentRankCategory = opp_RankCategory,

      Round = matches_played,
      OpponentRound = opp_matches_played,

      # Rest difference in days 
      Days = days_since_last_match - opp_days_since_last_match,

      RestAdvantage = case_when(
        is.na(Days) ~ "Equal",
        Days >= 2   ~ "More",
        Days <= -2  ~ "Less",
        TRUE        ~ "Equal"
      ), # Creates a categorical variable

      DWF = win_frequency - opp_win_frequency,
      DLF = loss_frequency - opp_loss_frequency,
      DDF = draw_frequency - opp_draw_frequency,

      DRF = red_cards_per_match - opp_red_cards_per_match,
      DYF = yellow_cards_per_match - opp_yellow_cards_per_match,
      DFF = fouls_per_match - opp_fouls_per_match,
      DCS = corners_per_match - opp_corners_per_match,
      DSTF = shots_on_target_per_match - opp_shots_on_target_per_match,
      DSF = shots_per_match - opp_shots_per_match
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        c(DRF, DYF, DFF, DCS, DSTF, DSF),
        ~ replace_na(.x, 0)
      ) # Starting values are 0s rather than NA
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      match_id, Year, Date, Team, Opponent, HomeAway,
      TeamRankCategory, OpponentRankCategory,
      Round, OpponentRound, RestAdvantage,
      DWF, DLF, DDF,
      attack_score, defence_score,
      opp_attack_score, opp_defence_score,
      DRF, DYF, DFF, DCS, DSTF, DSF,
      Goals = goals_for
    ) %>%
    arrange(match_id, desc(HomeAway == "Home"))
}
```

Then, I build the training set:
```{r} 

X13_14 <- read.csv("Data/13_14.csv")
X14_15 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/14_15.csv")
X15_16 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/15_16.csv")
X16_17 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/16_17.csv")
X17_18 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/17_18.csv")
X18_19 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/18_19.csv")
X19_20 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/19_20.csv")
X20_21 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/20_21.csv")
X21_22 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/21_22.csv")
X22_23 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/22_23.csv")
X23_24 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/23_24.csv")
X24_25 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/24_25.csv")
X25_26 <- read.csv("../Anna Del Pino/Premier League match events data/25_26.csv")
keep_cols <- names(X14_15)[1:23] # don't need the odds columns

match_data <- c("X14_15", "X15_16", "X16_17", "X17_18", "X18_19",
                "X19_20", "X20_21", "X21_22", "X22_23", "X23_24", "X24_25")

for (nm in match_data) {
  assign(nm, get(nm)[, keep_cols])  # get rid of odds columns for all datasets
}
X14_15 <- X14_15[-381,]

season_data <- list(
  "2014/15" = X14_15,
  "2015/16" = X15_16,
  "2016/17" = X16_17,
  "2017/18" = X17_18,
  "2018/19" = X18_19,
  "2019/20" = X19_20,
  "2020/21" = X20_21,
  "2021/22" = X21_22,
  "2022/23" = X22_23,
  "2023/24" = X23_24,
  "2024/25" = X24_25
)

previous_data <- list(
  X13_14,
  X14_15,
  X15_16,
  X16_17,
  X17_18,
  X18_19,
  X19_20,
  X20_21,
  X21_22,
  X22_23,
  X23_24
)

training_datasets <- lapply(
  seq_along(season_data),
  function(i) {
    build_season_dataset(
      current_data = season_data[[i]],
      previous_data = previous_data[[i]],
      season_label = names(season_data)[i],
      alpha = 0.1)
  }
) # this builds our training dataset 

training_data <- bind_rows(training_datasets)
write.csv(training_data, "training_data.csv") 
# saves it so that we don't need to recreate it, can call it later on.
```

```{r}
#In this chunk, I check that the code is correct 
# Any NA values?
sum(is.na(training_data))

difference_variables <- c(
  "DWF", "DLF", "DDF",
  "DRF", "DYF", "DFF",
  "DCS", "DSTF", "DSF"
)

symmetry_check <- training_data %>%
  group_by(match_id) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_rows = n(),
    number_home = sum(HomeAway == "Home"),
    number_away = sum(HomeAway == "Away"),

    across(
      all_of(difference_variables),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Every match should have exactly two rows: one home and one away
all(
  symmetry_check$number_of_rows == 2 &
  symmetry_check$number_home == 1 &
  symmetry_check$number_away == 1
)

# All difference variables should sum to zero
all(
  abs(as.matrix(
    symmetry_check[, difference_variables]
  )) < 1e-10
)

# This should give 0 rows:
training_data %>%
  count(match_id, Team) %>%
  filter(n != 1)
```
Everything looks good!
